subject: Escalation: Split remit + VAT/WHT docs blocking payment (Snowcrest/Pinecrest)
messages:
From: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
To: finance@pinecrest.ai
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Overdue: INV-2026-4009 — remittance options and VAT evidence needed

Hi Elena / Marco,

We're following up on INV-2026-4009 (due 2026-11-26, 60 days past due). Finance tells me payment attempts hit a cross-border routing block: the remittance was split between Pinecrest UK and Pinecrest Italy and our treasury couldn't reconcile VAT/VIES IDs for the Italian remit line. Additionally, the bank flagged a potential withholding tax (WHT) adjustment for the Italy payment.

Can you confirm the following by end of week so we can clear access and avoid service interruption?
- Which entity the payment should be applied to (UK vs IT)
- VAT/VIES registration for the Italian line (certificate or confirmation)
- Any WHT amount withheld and a reclaim timeline (we need the WHT certificate)

I've attached our copy of the invoice and the payment advice we received. If a partial remit to the UK entity would clear the account faster, we can accept that and apply a temporary credit to the Italian portion while you provide WHT evidence.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Collections Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@pinecrest.ai>

Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 10:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Overdue: INV-2026-4009 — remittance options and VAT evidence needed

Jonas — thanks for the clear note. Apologies for the delay; we ran into an internal AP split when the renewal invoice was routed to two entity payables during our re-org. Quick answers:
- Payment was initiated from Pinecrest Srl (Italy) for EUR 42,300 but our bank split EUR 30,000 to the UK ledger by mistake.
- Italian VAT ID is IT12345678901; I'm attaching the certificate and the bank advice.
- WHT: our finance team withheld a 10% WHT on the Italian line pending confirmation for reclaimability. We can provide a WHT certificate by COB Friday (2026-12-11).

If Redwood can provisionally release access against the UK-received funds (EUR 30k), we will clear the remaining EUR 12,300 within 7 business days of sending the WHT evidence. Alternatively, we can set a short-term credit while Treasury resolves the reclaim.

Best,
Elena
Elena Rossi
Head of Finance Operations | Pinecrest Analytics

On Thu, 10 Dec 2026 at 10:03 +0000 Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@pinecrest.ai> wrote:
> If Redwood can provisionally release access against the UK-received funds (EUR 30k), we will clear the remaining EUR 12,300 within 7 business days of sending the WHT evidence.

Thanks for the quick reply and the docs, Elena — attaching them into the record. Marissa / Kimberly — looped you both because Pinecrest is asking for a provisional partial release; they propose we keep the Italian portion pending WHT certificate.

Options I'm proposing for Operations to consider (need signoff):
1) Temporary partial unblock: accept EUR 30k as partial payment, lift service restrictions for core API access; hold remaining balance as 'pending WHT' but continue normal usage.
2) Hold until full entitlement: keep account on restricted mode until we receive WHT certificate + funds.
3) Move to a staged remediation: allow low-rate throughput access and throttle higher-cost paths until cleared.

Risk: if we allow partial access and the remainder fails, we may need to escalate collections and reduce support SLAs. Benefit: preserving product usage and retention while Treasury collects evidence.

Kimberly — do you approve a provisional partial release conditioned on documented WHT proof within 7 business days and a signed mutual action plan? If so I'll craft the conditional credit memo and legal clause.

Jonas
Attachment: wht-reclaim-evidence.xlsx (xlsx, 12KB)
From: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
To: jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Overdue: INV-2026-4009 — remittance options and VAT evidence needed

Jonas / Marissa — thanks for the summary. I'm authorizing Option 1 with the following firm conditions:
- Pinecrest must provide WHT certificate and bank confirmation by COB 2026-12-18.
- We will apply EUR 30,000 to the UK ledger immediately and issue a conditional credit note for EUR 12,300 to be voided if reclaim evidence is not provided in timeline.
- If evidence is not furnished by the 18th, account moves to credit hold and service will be restricted the next business day.

Marissa, please prepare the conditional credit memo and a short MAP (mutual action plan) for Elena to sign. Jonas, once they sign, coordinate with Ops to lift the limited restrictions (core API endpoints only). Keep legal copied on the MAP if any unusual clauses appear.

Kimberly Park
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
